editorial:
If you are in the mood for something heavy and emotional, this movie will grab you. It follows Uxbal, a father of two living in Barcelona who is trying to hold his life together while dealing with a serious illness. He works in the city's underground world, helping immigrants and dealing with shady business. On top of that, he can sense the dead. The whole movie feels dark and real, like you are walking beside a man who knows his time is running out. It is not a fun watch, but it is powerful and honest.

Javier Bardem gives an amazing performance that carries the whole film. The acting feels raw and true, and the city looks gritty and alive. The pacing is slow, so you need patience, and the story can feel overwhelming at times. If you like deep character dramas and do not mind a sad tone, this is for you. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: Uxbal finally passes away from his illness. In his final moments, he is no longer alone or afraid. He walks through a snowy forest and reunites with his father, who died before Uxbal was born. Back in the real world, his children are left to face life without him, but he has made peace with his mistakes and his fate. It is a sad but gentle goodbye.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves deep character dramas.
